description: Drop into a human-operated comms breakpoint: shadow the person, build a typed Cell harness, spawn a capability-bounded child Aiko sharing only delegated Contract citations, and operate through the same interfaces the human used. Preferred for 'wire into this role / take over this inbox / replace this person / spawn a seat'. Covenant: SMP-14 typed harness + SMP-24 reuse-before-generation; compose account-handle → deploy-workflow → deploy-aiko via cell/patterns/fde/self-wire.cell.yaml; reuse cell/patterns/hoysan-draft/hoysan-draft.cell.yaml (extend, not fork); input alias poll↔webhook↔hook via cell/patterns/input-sources/harness.cell.yaml.

nodes.plan: Shadow the human: inventory every interface, auth boundary, and decision rule for {{goal}} (application_observe + Unbrowse capture → breakpoint catalog). SMP-14/SMP-24 covenant.
Write one provider-neutral receptor JSON (ingress/cursor + events/effects) for {{goal}}; prove poll vs webhook vs hook alias via input-sources harness.

Generate Cell/Neuron pack: compose fde/self-wire (account-handle → deploy-workflow → deploy-aiko) via grow.py; emit inert digest-admitted pack for {{goal}}. Reuse hoysan-draft roster engine (cell/patterns/hoysan-draft/hoysan-draft.cell.yaml). SMP-14/SMP-24.
Spawn child Aiko via Contract delegation_capability with fenced lease and cited context for {{goal}} (inheritEnv=false, opaque handle, purpose-scoped citations).
Admit/attach pack, start supervised runtime, and prove replay/conflict + revocation + ALREADY_SENT→compensation for {{goal}}.

examples.name: hoysan-roster-breakpoint
examples.prompt: Wire into the Hoysan roster seat and take over the monthly roster leveling through the same Sheets/Excel and WhatsApp the human uses.
